title: CardioFusion-AI: Robust ECG--PPG Fusion for Multimodal Physiological Monitoring Under Signal Degradation
abstract: arXiv:2608.26000v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wearable electrocardiogram (ECG) and photoplethysmogram (PPG) sensors are complementary but individually fragile: motion artifact, poor contact, and sensor dropout can degrade one or both signals. Fusion strategies that assume both modalities are equally trustworthy can become less reliable than a single clean modality under degradation. We present CardioFusion-AI, a framework whose signal-processing front end, including R-peak and systolic-peak detection, an Orphanidou-type signal-quality index, and beat-by-beat pulse transit time estimation, is validated on 53 real intensive-care recordings (848 windows; heart-rate mean absolute error 1.61 bpm for ECG and 2.78 bpm for PPG) and a real annotated fetal ECG database (R-peak F1 0.89-0.98). translated_title: CardioFusion-AI：信号退化下用于多模态生理监测的稳健ECG-PPG融合方法
translated_abstract: 可穿戴心电图（ECG）和光电容积脉搏波（PPG）传感器具有互补性，但各自脆弱：运动伪影、接触不良和传感器丢失可能使其中一个或两个信号退化。假设两种模态同等可信的融合策略在信号退化时可能比单一干净模态更不可靠。我们提出了CardioFusion-AI框架，其信号处理前端包括R峰和收缩峰检测、Orphanidou型信号质量指数以及逐拍脉搏传播时间估计，并在53个真实重症监护记录（848个窗口；ECG心率平均绝对误差1.61 bpm，PPG为2.78 bpm）和一个真实标注的胎儿ECG数据库（R峰F1分数0.89-0.98）上进行了验证。随后，我们进行了一项受控的合成退化研究，比较了八种ECG-PPG融合策略在六种退化场景（涵盖分级损坏和完全模态丢失）下的表现，使用了五个独立指标。
tldr: 本文提出CardioFusion-AI框架，通过信号质量感知的融合策略，在ECG或PPG信号退化时仍能保持稳健的心率监测性能，优于假设双模态同等可信的传统融合方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents CardioFusion-AI, a signal-quality-aware ECG-PPG fusion framework that maintains robust heart-rate monitoring under signal degradation, outperforming traditional fusion methods that assume equal trustworthiness of both modalities.
